# Door window and switch electrical faults

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Order and install a new driver side power window switch by prying open its housing. [t58]

Turn the bulb socket a quarter turn counter-clockwise and pull it out. [t708]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Order a new driver side power window switch.
2. Pry open the old master switch housing to access internal components.

_Procedure reported by [t58]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t708] [Partial]</summary>

1. Turn the bulb socket a quarter turn counter-clockwise from inside behind the lens.
2. [Partial] Pull the socket out to remove it.

</details>
